responsibility: Provides the DFA scheduler model for the ARM1136J-S and ARM1136JF-S cores, including separate ALU/MAC and load-store pipelines and their shared writeback behavior. It defines instruction reservations and bypasses for integer arithmetic, shifts, multiply/accumulate forms, loads/stores, and control flow so scheduling for arm1136js/arm1136jfs can model the distinct execution resources and forwarding paths of that core family.
